U.S. Senator Adam Schiff plans to introduce a resolution making clear that Congress should not bail out AI companies or wealthy investors if the industry's boom falters,  Semafor reported on Monday, citing a person familiar with the matter.

The California Democrat's proposal says Congress must not “bail out corporations and wealthy investors taking speculative bets on the AI boom at the expense of working families, should the AI industry falter.”
Schiff did not immediately respond to a Seeking Alpha request for comment.
Schiff would be the first senator to introduce such a resolution, though similar efforts have emerged in the House of Representatives.

Democratic Representatives Greg Casar of Texas and Maxine Waters of California introduced a similar resolution last month. Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez of New York has also warned against a potential government bailout if the AI boom turns into a bubble.

title: Senator Adam Schiff plans no-AI-bailouts resolution: report
